# ceas

**Cellular Energetics Analysis Software**

[![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.1093%2Fbioinformatics%2Fbtae503-blue)](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btae503)

## Description

Measuring cellular energetics is essential to understanding a matrix’s
(e.g. cell, tissue or biofluid) metabolic state. The Agilent Seahorse
machine is a common method to measure real-time cellular energetics, but
existing analysis tools are highly manual or lack functionality. The
Cellular Energetics Analysis Software (ceas) R package fills this
analytical gap by providing modular and automated Seahorse data analysis
and visualization using the methods described by [Mookerjee et
al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.1074/jbc.m116.774471).

#### Pronunciation

‘ceas’ is pronounced like the word ‘seas’ (siːz, SEEZ).

## Installation

### CRAN

``` r
install.packages("ceas")
```

### Github

You can install the release or development versions from GitHub by
cloning the repo. The code on the `main` branch is in sync with the CRAN
releases while the `dev` branch has the latest updates. Documentation
for the dev branch can be found on the [dev
page](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/) of the website (`/dev`).

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/jamespeapen/ceas/
git clone -b dev https://github.com/jamespeapen/ceas/ # dev version
R CMD INSTALL ceas
```

You can also use the R [`devtools`](https://devtools.r-lib.org/)
package:

``` r
devtools::install_github("jamespeapen/ceas")
devtools::install_github("jamespeapen/ceas", ref = "dev") # dev version
```

or [`pak`](https://pak.r-lib.org/):

``` r
pak::pkg_install("jamespeapen/ceas")
pak::pkg_install("jamespeapen/ceas@dev") # dev version
```

## Usage

A user guide is available on the [package
website](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/). Bug reports may be
submitted through [GitHub
issues](https://github.com/jamespeapen/ceas/issues).

## Citation

If you use *ceas* please cite

Rachel (Rae) J House, James P Eapen, Hui Shen, Carrie R Graveel, Matthew
R Steensma (2024). ceas: An R package for Seahorse data analysis and
visualization, Bioinformatics, 40(8), btae503

## Contributing

Submit patches using GitHub pull requests or by sending a patch file to
<james.eapen@vai.org>. We follow the [tidyverse style
guide](https://style.tidyverse.org/) using
[styler](https://styler.r-lib.org/) and
[lintr](https://github.com/r-lib/lintr).

# Package index

## Data import

- [`read_data()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/read_data.md)
  : Read Seahorse Wave Excel File
- [`normalize()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/normalize.md)
  : Normalize Seahorse data
- [`partition_data()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/partition_data.md)
  : Organize Seahorse Data

## Energetics calculations

- [`get_energetics()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/get_energetics.md)
  : Calculate ATP Production from OXPHOS and Glycolysis
- [`get_energetics_summary()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/get_energetics_summary.md)
  : Calculate ATP Production Mean and Standard Deviation
- [`get_rate_summary()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/get_rate_summary.md)
  : Rates summary
- [`energetics_ols_summary()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/energetics_ols_summary.md)
  : Get ordinary least squares mean and confidence intervals from
  energetics
- [`energetics_lme_summary()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/energetics_lme_summary.md)
  : Get mean and confidence intervals from energetics mixed-effects
  models

## Plotting

- [`bioscope_plot()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/bioscope_plot.md)
  : Bioenergetic Scope Plot
- [`rate_plot()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/rate_plot.md)
  : Rate plot
- [`atp_plot()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/atp_plot.md)
  : ATP Plot
- [`make_bioscope_plot()`](https://jamespeapen.github.io/ceas/dev/reference/make_bioscope_plot.md)
  : Bioenergetic Scope Plot Shortcut
